findings.fsdQuote: A Random button on the library screen opens a randomly chosen series from that library.
findings.note: The library detail screen has no Random button; the only random behaviour is the dashboard's random-genre row.

findings.fsdQuote: Each row on the Home screen can be collapsed, and Kavita remembers the choice on the next visit.
findings.note: No collapse feature exists on the dashboard or its carousels.

findings.fsdQuote: Kavita removes a series from Want to Read automatically as soon as the user finishes reading it.
findings.note: Removal is done by a scheduled recurring cleanup job (CleanupWantToRead), not immediately on finishing.

findings.fsdQuote: The series in a collection can be exported to a CSV file.
findings.note: No CSV export exists in the collection screens.

findings.fsdQuote: The owner can share a reading list through a public link that opens without signing in.
findings.note: No public sharing link feature for reading lists exists in the code.

findings.fsdQuote: A filter box for finding items appears once a list has more than 25 items.
findings.note: The filter box appears when the list has more than 10 items.

findings.fsdQuote: A new password must be at least 8 characters long.
findings.note: The minimum password length is 6.

findings.fsdQuote: Users can turn on two-factor sign-in with an authenticator app.
findings.note: No two-factor authentication exists in the frontend.

findings.fsdQuote: When Prompt on Download is on, Kavita asks for confirmation before any download larger than 500 MB.
findings.note: The size threshold is 100 MB (104857600 bytes), not 500 MB.

findings.fsdQuote: Brightness can be set anywhere from 0% to 100%.
findings.note: Brightness (darkness) is validated between 10 and 100.

findings.fsdQuote: A slideshow mode turns the page automatically after a set number of seconds.
findings.note: The image reader has no slideshow mode.

findings.fsdQuote: Font size can be set from 50% to 200%.
findings.note: Font size is validated from 50 to 300.

findings.fsdQuote: Changes on this page are stored only when the administrator presses Save.
findings.note: General settings autosave (debounced 300ms) whenever the form is valid; there is no Save button.

findings.fsdQuote: A maintenance mode switch blocks all non-admin users from signing in until it is turned off.
findings.note: No maintenance mode setting exists in the code.

findings.fsdQuote: An invite can be given an expiry date, after which its link stops working.
findings.note: The invite form has no expiry date option.

findings.fsdQuote: Manage Collections is turned on by default for a new library.
findings.note: Manage Collections defaults to off (false) for a new library.
A Browse Genres screen exists but the FSD only describes People and Tags.
An All Annotations browse screen exists that the FSD does not describe.
An All Filters screen (smart filters list) exists that the FSD does not describe.
Preferences also has Share Profile and Include Unknowns (social max age rating) switches that the FSD does not mention.
